title: SMB bolus shows as a Meal bolus in record and on the display graph.
body:
When APS generates a SMB it shows correctly on the graph then changes to a meal bolus.

Running DEV 2.8.2.5
Medtronic 754
OL

I noticed that in the Dexcom app it was uploading results to NS.  I disabled this as I had it syncing in NSclient /syncronization/upload data to NS.

In also did not have share on in Dexcom app which is now enabled.
I think doing the changes above has solved the issue.
